Abaddon.goal: Save allies with Aphotic Shield dispel, can't die with Borrowed Time (heals from damage), Mist Coil heal/nuke.
Abaddon.requires: Aphotic Shield timing (dispels on cast), Borrowed Time awareness (auto-triggers or manual), Mist Coil targets.
Abaddon.fights: Aphotic Shield allies being stunned (instant dispel), Borrowed Time when you're focused (you heal from damage).
Abaddon.dont: Aphotic Shield after ally died, forget Borrowed Time can be dispelled, Mist Coil yourself when ally needs it.
Abaddon.timings: Vladmir's or Holy Locket 12-15 min for sustain. Aghs Shard enables offensive Mist Coil plays. Solar Crest timing for buffing carry.
Abaddon.gameStage: Early: trade aggressively in lane using Aphotic Shield, zone enemy with Mist Coil. Mid: stay with your core as a save hero, push with team using shield on frontliner. Late: stick to carry, use Borrowed Time to bait focus, dispel key disables with shield.

Alchemist.goal: Farm faster than any hero with Greevil's Greed, become 12-slotted (give Aghs to teammates), tank with Chemical Rage regen.
Alchemist.requires: Uncontested farm (team creates space), Radiance timing, Aghs gifting priority decisions, Chemical Rage during fights.
Alchemist.fights: Chemical Rage before engaging (not after), tank with high regen, Acid Spray for armor reduction, Concoction stun.
Alchemist.dont: Fight without Chemical Rage, farm jungle when lanes available, gift Aghs before your core items.
Alchemist.timings: Radiance before 15 min is critical. Aghs gift to ally by 25 min. BKB + AC by 30 min for teamfight dominance.
Alchemist.gameStage: Early: stack camps or have supports stack, farm mid with Acid Spray. Mid: farm Radiance then flash farm jungle and lanes, avoid fights until 2-3 items. Late: gift Aghs to allies, frontline with Chemical Rage and AC, fight with team at objectives.

Ancient Apparition.goal: Counter healing globally with Ice Blast shatter, setup with Cold Feet stun, slow with Ice Vortex amp, Chilling Touch harass.
Ancient Apparition.requires: Ice Blast aim and timing (on low HP/healing heroes), Cold Feet setup (needs slow or stun first), Ice Vortex amp.
Ancient Apparition.fights: Ice Vortex for magic amp, Cold Feet with setup, Ice Blast globally to kill low HP and prevent healing.
Ancient Apparition.dont: Ice Blast full HP targets, Cold Feet without setup, forget Ice Vortex magic amp.
Ancient Apparition.timings: Aghs Shard for Ice Blast impact. Force Staff or Glimmer 15-20 min for survival. Aghs extends Ice Blast debuff.
Ancient Apparition.gameStage: Early: harass with Chilling Touch from range, use Cold Feet with lane partner setup. Mid: stay behind team, use Ice Blast on fights across map, farm with Ice Vortex + Chilling Touch. Late: position far back, land Ice Blast on clumped enemies, never frontline.

Anti-Mage.goal: Farm faster than anyone via Blink mobility, burn mana to cripple casters, delete heroes with Mana Void, become very hard to kill late with Counterspell.
Anti-Mage.requires: Safe farm for Battle Fury (before 16 min ideal), team willing to 4v5 while you accelerate, Manta timing for dispel and illusion pressure. Strong against int/mana-dependent lineups.
Anti-Mage.fights: Split push until you have 2-3 items, then Blink onto isolated backline targets. Save Counterspell for big spells. Use Mana Void when enemies are low mana for max damage.
Anti-Mage.dont: Fight early without core items (exception: defending high ground or critical objectives), skip BFury for "fighting build", Blink aggressively into multiple heroes, pick into physical damage lineups that ignore mana burn.
Anti-Mage.timings: Battle Fury before 16 min. Manta Style 22-25 min. Abyssal Blade or Butterfly 30-35 min. Each item increases farm rate and fight potential.
Anti-Mage.gameStage: Early: farm safe lane, avoid fights, get last hits with Mana Break harass. Mid: split push triangle and side lanes after Battle Fury, join fights only with Manta timing. Late: group with team for objectives, Blink onto backline when team initiates.

Arc Warden.goal: Create overwhelming map pressure with Tempest Double clone. Farm multiple locations, siege highground safely, win through item/economic advantage.
Arc Warden.requires: Micro skills for clone management, Midas timing, Gleipnir/Maelstrom for wave clear, understanding which items duplicate (Midas, BKB, Refresher).
Arc Warden.fights: Send clone in first to use items and test enemy reactions. Keep real hero safe. Use Magnetic Field for save, Spark Wraiths for zoning.
Arc Warden.dont: Send clone to die for nothing (it feeds gold), forget to use clone's items, pick into heavy gank lineups without vision.
Arc Warden.timings: Hand of Midas before 12 min. Gleipnir 20-22 min for root + farm. Hex or Nullifier 30+ min. Clone doubles item value.
Arc Warden.gameStage: Early: harass with Spark Wraith and Flux, farm safe lane. Mid: split push with Tempest Double in one lane while farming another, avoid committing main hero. Late: siege high ground with Double, push two lanes simultaneously, use Magnetic Field for tower defense.

Axe.goal: Force enemies to attack you with Berserker's Call, spin to win with Counter Helix procs, execute with Culling Blade, cut waves.
Axe.requires: Blink for Call initiation, lane cutting to disrupt carry farm, Blade Mail synergy, Call into Cull combo.
Axe.fights: Blink into multiple enemies, Call them, spin procs while Blade Mail reflects, Culling Blade threshold kills.
Axe.dont: Call one support when you could get multiple or the carry (exception: killing a key target or saving an ally), Blade Mail without being focused, pick into magic damage (Helix needs attacks).
Axe.timings: Blink Dagger 10-14 min enables initiation. Blade Mail + Blink timing is the first major spike. BKB 20-25 min for reliable calls.
Axe.gameStage: Early: cut creep waves behind enemy tower, pressure carry with Battle Hunger. Mid: blink initiate on grouped enemies, farm jungle between ganks. Late: Blink-Call priority targets, frontline for team, threaten Culling Blade threshold.

Bane.requires: Fiend's Grip channel protection, Nightmare on right target, Brain Sap as nuke and heal.
Bane.fights: Nightmare setup, Fiend's Grip priority target (channel must be protected), Brain Sap for damage and sustain.
Bane.dont: Grip where you get interrupted, Nightmare your carry, waste Grip on support.
Bane.timings: Aether Lens 15-18 min for safe Grip range. BKB or Glimmer for uninterrupted Fiend's Grip. Aghs Shard for AoE Nightmare.

Batrider.fights: Blink in, Lasso priority target, Firefly and drag them back to team. Napalm stacks amplify all damage.
Batrider.dont: Lasso without team nearby (can't kill solo), Firefly and then walk on ground, skip Blink.
Batrider.timings: Blink Dagger 12-15 min for Lasso initiation. BKB 20-22 min for uninterrupted Lasso. Refresher late for double Lasso.
Batrider.gameStage: Early: harass with Sticky Napalm stacks, zone melee heroes, push wave. Mid: Blink-Lasso priority targets, farm jungle with Firefly. Late: initiate with Blink-Lasso from fog, pull targets into your team, stack Napalm in teamfights.

Bristleback.goal: Tank damage from behind with Bristleback passive damage reduction, stack Warpath for increasing damage and speed, harass with Quill Spray stacks and Viscous Nasal Goo armor reduction.
Bristleback.requires: Facing away from damage sources for Bristleback passive, Quill Spray stack buildup in fights, mana sustain for spell spam, tank items to stay alive long enough.
Bristleback.fights: Face away from damage, spam Quill Spray to stack damage, Viscous Nasal Goo to reduce armor. Warpath stacks increase your damage and speed the longer you fight.
Bristleback.dont: Face enemies directly (lose Bristleback passive reduction), fight without mana for spells, pick into Silver Edge (breaks passive), short fights where Warpath can't stack.

Viper.goal: Win any 1v1 with Nethertoxin break and damage, chase with Poison Attack slow, zone with Corrosive Skin.

Viper.fights: Nethertoxin under enemy (breaks passives), Poison Attack slow, Viper Strike for slow. Very oppressive 1v1.

Visage.goal: Burst with Soul Assumption stacks, dominate with Familiar summons, tank with Gravekeeper's Cloak layers.

Visage.fights: Familiars dive and stun, Soul Assumption when stacks are up, Cloak layers make you tanky.
Visage.dont: Let Familiars die (3 hits and dead, long CD), miss Familiar stuns, ignore Soul Assumption damage.

Void Spirit.fights: Aether Remnant to pull enemies, Astral Step in for burst damage, Resonant Pulse for shield and AoE damage, Dissimilate to dodge or reposition.
Void Spirit.dont: Waste Astral Step charges (need one for escape), Dissimilate predictably, fight without Resonant Pulse shield, pick into silences that prevent escape.
Void Spirit.timings: Orchid or Witch Blade 12-14 min. BKB 18-20 min. Aghs or Hex 25-28 min. Resonant Pulse at level 2 enables mid trades. Dissimilate + Aether Remnant combo from level 3.

Weaver.goal: Harass and escape with Shukuchi invis and max speed, apply Geminate Attack double hits, armor reduce with The Swarm, Time Lapse to undo damage.
Weaver.requires: Shukuchi for constant repositioning and harass, Geminate Attack procs, The Swarm for armor reduction and vision, Time Lapse timing (reverts HP/position to 5 sec ago).
Weaver.fights: Shukuchi in and out for damage, Geminate Attack on priority targets, The Swarm on enemy team for armor reduction. Time Lapse when low HP to reset.
Weaver.dont: Time Lapse too late (dead before pressing it), stay visible without Shukuchi (very squishy), forget The Swarm reduces armor, pick into silences and AoE detection.
Weaver.timings: Maelstrom or Desolator 12-14 min. BKB or Linken's 18-22 min. Skadi 25-28 min. Shukuchi from level 1 enables harass. Time Lapse at 6 is a survival spike.
Weaver.gameStage: Early: harass with Geminate Attack double hit, Shukuchi for trades and escape. Mid: pick off supports with Shukuchi, The Swarm for armor reduction, Time Lapse to survive. Late: hit backline with Shukuchi, Time Lapse to reset HP, Geminate for double damage.
Weaver.patchNotes: 7.40: Increased The Swarm damage per instance from 18/22/26/30 to 18/23/28/33.; Aghanim's Scepter upgrade: Now also reduces Time Lapse cooldown by 10.

Windranger.gameStage: Early: harass with Powershot, Windrun to dodge attacks, Shackleshot for kills. Mid: Blink-Shackleshot into Focus Fire, Powershot for wave clear. Late: Focus Fire to melt single targets, Shackleshot for latch stun, Windrun to survive.
